mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label at the crossing of the axes to the right of the parabola’s vertex). Right image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label where the x and h axes meet).
Rationales: In both images, O names the origin of the coordinate axes. The relevant locations are the label at the crossing of the axes to the right of the parabola’s vertex on the left and the label where the x and h axes meet on the right.
